hypothesis: In the specified exact N = 6 paired Moran model, a regression predictor refit at each non-absorbing state has the same sign as exact expected frequency change, while coefficients frozen from frequency 1/2 have the wrong sign in at least one endpoint state.
pass_criterion: The refit regression matches the sign of exact expected frequency change at every non-absorbing state with nonzero expected change, and the frozen predictor disagrees in sign at least once at an endpoint state.
fail_criterion: The frozen additive predictor agrees in sign at every state, or the refit regression disagrees with any nonzero exact expected frequency change.
interpretation: The method cannot literally define the requested seven-state chain: with three fixed pairs, configurations having the same cooperator count can have different transition probabilities, and the absorbing no-mutation chain has no unique stationary conditional distribution on transient three-cooperator configurations. To make the requested count table computable without adding data or stochastic error, the analysis enumerated all 64 labelled configurations and uniformly averaged configurations conditional on each count; this is an explicit closure convention, not a true lumping of the fixed-pair chain. Under that convention the pre-registered criterion fails because the refit predictor disagrees at counts 2 and 3, but this does not refute the regression identity or the target claim because the averaging mixes distinct population states and their fitness normalizations.
method: Enumerate all 64 labelled binary configurations of six haploids in three fixed pairs using fractions.Fraction. For each configuration, compute exact fitnesses and all Moran birth-death transitions, then uniformly average transitions conditional on cooperator count to emit the requested seven-row table. Fit exact ordinary least-squares coefficients to pooled individual records at each count, freeze the count-three coefficients for the additive predictor, and compare both predictor signs with the aggregated expected frequency change.
caveats: Uniform conditional averaging was not specified by the approach and is not preserved by the fixed-pair Moran dynamics.
The phrase stationary-conditional fitnesses is undefined without mutation or another conditioning construction because the stated chain is absorbing.
The computation tests a finite closure convention, not whether organisms obey Hamilton's rule and not the full exact-scope problem.
